name: Technical Discovery Starter (Six Habits)
description: A starter set of technical-discovery questions from The Six Habits of Highly Effective Sales Engineers. Use them verbatim or adapt them to your selling situation. Guiding principle: ask in the customer's context, not yours — frame every question from their perspective.

stages.title: Project overview
stages.objective: Hear the project in the customer's own words before you frame it in yours.
stages.primary_prompt: Could I trouble you to provide me with an overview of the project in your own words?
completion_criteria: The customer has described the project and its scope in their own words.

stages.title: Why now
stages.objective: Understand what prompted them to evaluate tools like yours.
stages.primary_prompt: Is it possible to provide some background as to why you're looking at tools such as ours?
completion_criteria: The trigger or motivation for the evaluation is recorded.

stages.title: Prior experience
stages.objective: Learn from past attempts — what was tried, how it went, and why it succeeded or failed.
stages.primary_prompt: Does the organization have any previous experience with other tools or solutions like ours? If so, how did it go? If it failed, why?
completion_criteria: Prior tools/solutions and their outcomes are captured.

stages.title: Desired outcome
stages.objective: Pin down what they ultimately hope to accomplish.
stages.primary_prompt: At the end of the day, what are you hoping to accomplish with this solution or with this project?
completion_criteria: The intended business outcome of the project is recorded.

stages.title: Definition of success
stages.objective: Make success concrete and measurable in their terms.
stages.primary_prompt: What does success look like for your organization?
completion_criteria: A concrete definition of success is captured.

stages.title: Standards and frameworks
stages.objective: Surface any standards, frameworks, or guidelines they must or want to follow.
stages.primary_prompt: Are there specific industry standards, frameworks, or guidelines that you are required to do or attempting to follow? Are you even familiar with them and are they important to you?
completion_criteria: Relevant standards/frameworks and their importance are recorded.

stages.title: Target areas
stages.objective: Identify the business areas, domains, or teams they want to start with.
stages.primary_prompt: Are there certain business areas, domains, or internal organizations that you are targeting or focusing on to begin with?
completion_criteria: Initial target areas or organizations are identified.

stages.title: Demonstration context
stages.objective: Decide whether the demo must be set in their business context to land.
stages.primary_prompt: Will the business context of the demonstration make a difference to you and your group?
alternative_prompts: For example: if they are an insurance agency, will a demonstration that includes sample data from a fictitious manufacturing company make it difficult for them to follow?
completion_criteria: Whether the demo needs their business context is decided.

stages.title: Sample data
stages.objective: If context matters, find out whether they can supply representative sample data.
stages.primary_prompt: If so, do they have any sample data that they could provide to be included in the demonstration?
completion_criteria: Availability of sample data for the demo is confirmed.

stages.title: Required capabilities
stages.objective: Capture the specific capabilities they are looking for.
stages.primary_prompt: Are there specific capabilities that you're looking for?

stages.title: Attendees and roles
stages.objective: Know who will attend and what each person's role and stake is.
stages.primary_prompt: Who's going to be in attendance? What are their roles? Are they hands-on users, technical principals, management, decision makers, etc.?
completion_criteria: Attendees and their roles are identified.

stages.title: Meeting logistics
stages.objective: Confirm the practical logistics so the session runs without surprises.
stages.primary_prompt: What are the meeting logistics? Is it a secure environment? Will I have internet access? Are we meeting in a conference room or someone's office?
completion_criteria: Environment, connectivity, and location logistics are confirmed.
